verses.2: I said, “I will keep my ways away from evil. I will follow His laws, even though the wicked oppose it.”
verses.3: I am distressed by my own actions; they are both good and bad. My pain is unbearable.
verses.4: My heart burns with anger; in my chest, fire flares up. I speak in a strange manner.
verses.5: May the LORD inform me, at this critical moment in my life, what it is that I must stop doing.
verses.6: Look, they have been given days to live; but my flesh and bones are like a desert against you. But all darkness, all people, stand in fear.
verses.7: But in their own way, people will still go on living. Their bodies will remain alive, but they won’t know who gathered them together.
verses.8: And now, what have I done, Adonai? It is time for me to begin with you.
verses.9: From all my sins, save me from the disgrace of a monster. Do not let me be destroyed.
verses.10: I will not open my mouth, because you have done this.
verses.11: The dust from above touched you, due to the friction of your hands. I am all alone.
verses.12: In his anger, he removed one person from the crowd. He acted like a cruel man, but everyone was filled with sorrow.
verses.13: Hear my prayers, O LORD! Listen to my supplications. I beg you to hear my voice and listen to me. For I dwell among you, just like all my ancestors did.
verses.14: Please leave me alone, and don’t be sad before I go. I really don’t want to do that.
